mapper.select: SELECT e.school_id, e.offering_id, e.student_id, o.teacher_id, e.status AS enrollment_status FROM enrollment e JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = e.offering_id WHERE e.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND e.student_id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: grade.id, grade.school_id AS schoolId, school.school_name AS schoolName, grade.offering_id AS offeringId, offering.offering_code AS offeringCode, course.course_name AS courseName, course.category, offering.term, grade.student_id AS studentId, student.student_no AS studentNo, student.full_name AS studentName, sc.class_name AS className, sc.grade AS gradeLevel, grade.teacher_id AS teacherId, teacher.full_name AS teacherName, grade.score, grade.learning_evaluation AS learningEvaluation, grade.recorded_at AS recordedAt, grade.updated_at AS updatedAt, updater.display_name AS updatedByName
mapper.select: SELECT FROM student_grade grade JOIN school ON school.id = grade.school_id JOIN course_offering offering ON offering.id = grade.offering_id JOIN course ON course.id = offering.course_id JOIN student ON student.id = grade.student_id JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = student.class_id JOIN teacher ON teacher.id = grade.teacher_id JOIN sys_user updater ON updater.id = grade.updated_by WHERE grade.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND grade.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT e.student_id AS studentId, student.student_no AS studentNo, student.full_name AS studentName, sc.class_name AS className, grade.id AS gradeId, grade.score, grade.learning_evaluation AS learningEvaluation, grade.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM enrollment e JOIN course_offering offering ON offering.id = e.offering_id JOIN student ON student.id = e.student_id JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = student.class_id LEFT JOIN student_grade grade ON grade.offering_id = e.offering_id AND grade.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND offering.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND e.status = 'ENROLLED' ORDER BY sc.grade, sc.class_name, student.student_no

SELECT FROM student_grade grade JOIN school ON school.id = grade.school_id JOIN course_offering offering ON offering.id = grade.offering_id JOIN course ON course.id = offering.course_id JOIN student ON student.id = grade.student_id JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = student.class_id JOIN teacher ON teacher.id = grade.teacher_id JOIN sys_user updater ON updater.id = grade.updated_by
JOIN student_guardian binding ON binding.student_id = grade.student_id AND binding.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND binding.is_active = TRUE
WHERE grade.school_id = #{schoolId} AND grade.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND grade.student_id = #{studentId} AND grade.offering_id = #{offeringId} ORDER BY grade.updated_at DESC, grade.id DESC

SELECT offering.id AS offeringId, offering.offering_code AS offeringCode, course.course_name AS courseName, teacher.full_name AS teacherName, COUNT(grade.id) AS gradedCount, ROUND(AVG(grade.score), 2) AS averageScore, SUM(CASE WHEN grade.score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN grade.score BETWEEN 80 AND 89.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN grade.score BETWEEN 60 AND 79.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN grade.score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS needsSupportCount FROM course_offering offering JOIN course ON course.id = offering.course_id JOIN teacher ON teacher.id = offering.teacher_id LEFT JOIN student_grade grade ON grade.offering_id = offering.id WHERE offering.school_id = #{schoolId} AND offering.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY offering.id, offering.offering_code, course.course_name, teacher.full_name ORDER BY course.course_name, offering.offering_code

SELECT revision.id, revision.old_score AS oldScore, revision.new_score AS newScore, revision.old_learning_evaluation AS oldLearningEvaluation, revision.new_learning_evaluation AS newLearningEvaluation, actor.display_name AS changedByName, revision.changed_at AS changedAt FROM student_grade_revision revision JOIN student_grade grade ON grade.id = revision.grade_id JOIN sys_user actor ON actor.id = revision.changed_by WHERE revision.grade_id = #{gradeId} AND revision.school_id = #{schoolId} AND grade.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY revision.changed_at DESC, revision.id DESC
